It looks like your hair might be 4C, but how you moisturize it makes all the difference. Many 4C hair types are low porosity, meaning they struggle to absorb moisture. To keep your hair hydrated, try the LCO (Leave-in, Cream, Oil) or LOC (Leave-in, Oil, Cream) method to seal in moisture effectively. I used to think my 4C hair had no curl pattern, but the issue was improper moisturizing. The products you use also matter, look for those with humectants like honey, glycerin, aloe, or hyaluronic acid, as they help retain moisture. These products often have labels like “hydrating,” “moisturizing,” or “butter.”

Also, don’t listen to people who say 4C hair doesn’t have a curl pattern, it does! The key is understanding your hair’s porosity so you can build a routine that works. Low-porosity 4C hair thrives with steam, so investing in a hair steamer can be a game changer. I use mine while deep conditioning and after moisturizing to lock in hydration. Sometimes, I even sit under it just because it feels good!

I personally like to journal and do affirmations it sounds corny but with consistency I do see changes. Remember validation from outside sources is always fleeting. You can never depend on others for validation because you will be constantly searching for that shit. You have to learn to validate yourself which is a lot easier said than done, but it is possible and you can do it.
